_comment: Per-client network/compute profiles used by the WAN emulator (fedcloud/netemu.py). rtt_ms = round-trip latency, bw_mbps = link bandwidth, compute_factor = slowdown vs. base_compute_s per local epoch. Profiles approximate free-tier nodes in different regions/providers. Set FEDCLOUD_NO_EMU=1 on real cloud nodes to disable emulation and measure the real network.
